description_en: Call the CancelCall operation to cancel incoming and outgoing calls initiated by ClickToDial
description_zh: 调用CancelCall接口取消ClickToDial发起的语音双呼
name: CancelCall

parameters.help_en: The unique receipt ID for this call. Obtain it from the return information of the ClickToDial (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114040.htm) interface
parameters.help_zh: 此次通话的唯一回执ID。可以从ClickToDial (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114040.htm)接口的返回信息中获取
parameters.name: call_id
